lin_chen.fallback_strategy: Tier 1: custom_anchors/lin_chen.{wav,mp3,m4a,flac} single-speaker bilingual EN+ZH studio cut (mandatory for production; never auto-downloads a Mandarin-only clip); Tier 2: repo-bundled voice_anchors/lin_chen.wav; Tier 3: curated single-speaker EN+ZH bilingual reference from OpenMOSS MOSS-TTSD / LibriTTS-R booth sessions; Tier 4: dedicated single-speaker human close-mic booth recording (strictly NEVER synthetic TTS).
lin_chen.anchor_text: That eighty-million-dollar loss is a phantom number—not a cash loss, and you know it. 她把可转债重估包装成经营失血，不是看不懂财报，是想趁签约前把估值砍掉三成。

bilingual_same_speaker_protocol.age_vocal_profile: 30-38yo male bilingual baritone (Stanford/Silicon Valley + Shenzhen hardware CEO register, restrained chest resonance, zero announcer cadence)
bilingual_same_speaker_protocol.spliced_bilingual_anchor_ratio_en_zh: 55:45 (7-9s Silicon Valley General American English + 5-7s restrained Mandarin, 12-16s total from the exact same close-mic studio session)
bilingual_same_speaker_protocol.paired_en_zh_audition_ab_test: Render AUDITION_GLOBAL_EDGE with Candidate A (single 14s spliced EN+ZH anchor from one speaker) vs Candidate B (same-speaker EN-only and ZH-only paired stems) and lock the winner via Gate G1 blind speaker-identity and formant-consistency check.
anti_accent_bleed_rules: Use strictly one real human vocal tract across EN and ZH to lock fundamental frequency (F0) and vocal-tract formants.
Capture English and Mandarin sentences in the same dry close-mic studio session with identical mic distance and preamp gain.
Eliminate Chinese flat-vowel transfer or syllable-timing bleed on English boardroom lines (preserve rhotic /r/, American alveolar flapping, and nuclear stress).
Eliminate Western prosodic drift or textbook reading cadence on Mandarin inner_monologue and Act 5 debrief lines.
Strictly disable afftdn spectral denoising so upper-formant speaker identity cues remain intact.

zhou_mo.anchor_text: 产线刚把微显示模组的 BOM cost 压掉十八美金，硅谷那边又要为公有云 token 账单多烧三十块。听好了，明天切回端侧推理，不然卖一台亏一台。
